purpose: A framed grid of product capabilities under an optional section title: each cell is a `Topic` (glyph, heading, sentence) with optional bullet points, three or four to a row. From the design sample's site `CapabilityGrid`.
useWhen: A product page listing what the product does, three or six at a time.
A bare grid (no title) under a band that already has its heading.
avoidWhen: For capabilities with art — use `FeatureTiles` or `BentoGrid`.
For links to other pages — use `UseCaseLinks` or `ResourceGrid`.
bestPractices: Three or six items at three columns, four or eight at four, so rows stay full.
Keep points to three short lines.

Set `titleKind: 'left'` for a band whose header sits at the start edge (the Partners page's "Why you should be a partner"); the grid keeps its title, so each capability stays an `h3`. Never wrap a bare grid in `SectionModule` to move the title: the capability headings rise to `h2` and the outline breaks.
